I don't usually comment on Youtube videos, feels a little like shouting into the void. But I noticed a pretty huge error in this video, and kinda makes me wonder what other errors are in these videos that I don't notice.

2:06 - "At that time [2006], only about 1% of all Coke fountains in the US even offered Diet Coke."

Having been pretty far into my addiction to Diet Coke by 2006, I have firsthand (admittedly anecdotal) evidence that this is wholly untrue. Basically every single soda fountain that served coke at the time (and still to this day) had Diet Coke. I'd guess the number was closer to 90%. I never physically saw a fountain without Diet Coke, but maybe some regions it's not as popular. Unsure.

So I dug into the video's sources at that timestamp. Both sources listed onscreen during that quote indicate that Caffeine-Free Diet Coke is what was rare in fountains. That is an entirely different drink.

Is this a crucial point to the story? No, not really. But it's one of the rare times a video talks about something I have firsthand knowledge of, so when that happens and it's just wrong, it makes me less certain about the facts presented in these documentaries.
